reviews.author: reena khanna
reviews.text:
My experience at Big Bay, Haldiram, and Baskin Robbins was extremely disappointing and unacceptable. The overall hygiene, cleanliness, and food quality were shockingly poor.

The dining area was not clean — tables were sticky, floors looked badly maintained, and the food service area appeared unhygienic and unorganised. Utensils did not look properly cleaned, raising serious concerns about food safety.

The bathroom was dirty and poorly maintained, which further reflected the complete lack of hygiene standards in this place.

The food at Big Bay and Haldiram was bland, tasteless, and poorly prepared, with no freshness or flavour. For the prices charged, this level of food quality is simply not acceptable.

The experience at Baskin Robbins was equally bad. There was no air conditioning, making the outlet uncomfortable, and the ice cream tasted stale, which is extremely concerning for a brand known for desserts.

Overall, this visit was a complete letdown. Unless immediate improvements are made in cleanliness, hygiene, maintenance, and food quality, I would strongly recommend avoiding this place.

reviews.author: Ruchika Gupta
reviews.text:
Stopped by at this place on the way back from
adiyogi. The place is beautiful and neat . But it was raining so toilet floors were wet and messy . There are only 5-6 restaurants . We went to Haldiram, Leon’s and everywhere they had very militia food availability from the menu . Even Starbucks had only 4/5 items . It was surprising to see that not even half the items from the menu were available on Sunday at 8pm in all these restaurants . We finally went to KfC coz they had all the items available . Empire restaurant was good and had a variety of dishes . Taking away 2 stars coz of non availability of dishes . I wish the food court restaurants are better stocked otherwise it defeats the purpose of being an highway food court stop .

reviews.author: Abhilash Pradhan
reviews.text: Big Bay India Food Mall is a welcome oasis along the highway, offering a plethora of dining options amidst a stretch devoid of alternatives. From international chains like Burger King, Starbucks, KFC, and Baskin Robbins to local favorites such as Empire Restaurant and GoPizza, there's something to satiate every palate. The inclusion of clean and well-equipped toilet facilities, along with a refueling station, makes it a convenient pitstop for travelers. The design exudes the charm of a well-maintained food street, with ample parking space ensuring hassle-free access. Whether craving a quick bite or a leisurely meal, Big Bay India Food Mall delivers on both variety and convenience, making it a standout stopover for highway travelers.

reviews.author: Ajay Raj Achary
reviews.text:
Big Bay, India, is a traveler's paradise, tucked away on the Bangalore-Hyderabad Highway (around 90km from Bglr) and very ideal for pit stop. The environment offers a much-needed break from the road, the cuisine selection pleases all palates, and the facilities are immaculate. It is the highest quality, whether you are having a leisurely meal or a fast coffee. Big Bay India sets the bar high for highway stops.

Update 5th Aug 2024 (Second visit) :
On the way back from Lepakshi, we made a lunch break at Big Bay. The space is spacious, tidy, well-kept, and well-organized.
There are numerous culinary selections. Empire was our choice and the food was good.

Parking/Restroom:
There is plenty of room for parking, which is convenient for people who are arriving by bus or car. They even offer a kids' area, EV charging, and a Jio fuel station.
An important consideration for long-distance visitors is the restrooms in Big Bay, which are kept in excellent condition.

Outlets :
Empire, Starbucks, KFC, Burger King, Baskin-Robbins, GoPizza, Leon's, Haldiram’s , Ajfan Dates & Nuts , etc and many more to come .

reviews.author: Mohammed Jawad
reviews.text:
On September 6th, during my visit to Big Bay, I noticed that a few restaurants were still undergoing construction. The only dining options available at the time were KFC and Gopizza, both of which had limited operating hours. Nevertheless, it proved to be a tranquil and serene spot to unwind after a lengthy drive.

Big Bay boasts ample parking space, which is a convenient feature for visitors. Unfortunately, during my visit, restroom facilities were unavailable. Nonetheless, despite this inconvenience, I managed to have a peaceful and enjoyable time at Big Bay.
